task_groups.title: Write tests for afc secrets subcommands

subtasks.title: Scaffold secrets_cmd_test.go with httptest helpers

subtasks.title: Write happy-path tests for afc secrets create (single scope)
details: Test `afc secrets create KEY=val` with no flags → expects POST to `/api/v1/user/secrets` with body `{"entries":[{"key":"KEY","value":"val"}]}`.
Test `afc secrets create KEY=val --org myorg` → expects POST to `/api/v1/orgs/myorg/secrets`.
Test `afc secrets create KEY=val --workspace myws` → expects POST to `/api/v1/workspaces/myws/secrets`.
Assert stdout contains the JSON response from the mock server and exit code is 0.

subtasks.title: Write multi-scope create test for afc secrets create
details: Test `afc secrets create KEY=val --user --org myorg` → expects two POST calls in order: first to `/api/v1/user/secrets`, then to `/api/v1/orgs/myorg/secrets`.
Assert both responses are printed to stdout and exit code is 0.
Test partial failure: mock org scope to return HTTP 500 → assert `hadError` path returns exit code 1 and user-scope output was already printed.
Test `--user --org myorg --workspace myws` → three calls in user → org → workspace order.

subtasks.title: Write argument validation error tests for afc secrets create
details: Test `afc secrets create NOEQUALS` → expects exit code 2 with error message about missing `=`.
Test `afc secrets create KEY=val,,KEY2=val2` → expects exit code 2 with message `empty key in argument at position 1`.
Test `afc secrets create` (no args) → expects exit code 2.
Assert no HTTP calls are made to the mock server in all error cases.

subtasks.title: Write happy-path and error tests for afc secrets list, update, delete
details: Test `afc secrets list` (no flags) → GET `/api/v1/user/secrets`, stdout has JSON array.
Test `afc secrets list --org myorg --workspace myws` → expects exit code 2 (multiple selectors).
Test `afc secrets update KEY=newval --workspace myws` → PATCH `/api/v1/workspaces/myws/secrets/KEY` with body `{"value":"newval"}`.
Test `afc secrets update NOEQUALS` → exit code 2.
Test `afc secrets delete mykey --org myorg` → DELETE `/api/v1/orgs/myorg/secrets/mykey`, stdout silent, stderr has `Secret 'mykey' has been deleted.`.
Test `afc secrets delete` (no args) → exit code 2.

task_groups.title: Implement key=value argument parsing and ownership selector helpers

subtasks.title: Implement parseKeyValue helper function
details: Add `parseKeyValue(arg string) (key, value string, err error)` in a shared internal helper (e.g. top of `secrets_cmd.go` or a small `cli_util.go`).
Split on the first `=` using `strings.SplitN(arg, "=", 2)`; if len < 2 return `apikit.NewCLIError(2, "invalid argument: missing '=' in '" + arg + "'")`.
Key is `parts[0]`, value is `parts[1]` (value may contain `=`).
Return the parsed key and value on success.

subtasks.title: Implement parseKeyValueList helper for multi-entry create
details: Add `parseKeyValueList(arg string) ([]entry, error)` where `entry` is `struct{ Key, Value string }`.
Split `arg` on `,` to get individual `key=value` tokens.
For each token at position N: if empty or whitespace-only key after `parseKeyValue`, return `apikit.NewCLIError(2, fmt.Sprintf("empty key in argument at position %d", N))`.
Return the slice of entries on success.

subtasks.title: Implement ownership selector resolution helper
details: Add `resolveScope(userFlag bool, orgFlag, workspaceFlag string) []scopeTarget` where `scopeTarget` holds the API path prefix.
If all three flags are at zero values (`!userFlag && orgFlag == "" && workspaceFlag == ""`), default to user scope.
Otherwise include each non-zero flag as a scope in fixed order: user → org → workspace.
Return the ordered slice of scope targets for use by create commands.

subtasks.title: Implement single-selector enforcement for list/update/delete
details: Add `singleScope(userFlag bool, orgFlag, workspaceFlag string) (scopeTarget, error)` that returns exactly one scope or `apikit.NewCLIError(2, "only one of --user, --org, --workspace may be specified")` if multiple are set.
Apply the same default-to-user logic when no flags are provided.
This helper is used by `list`, `update`, and `delete` subcommands in both `secrets_cmd.go` and `vars_cmd.go`.

checks: Unit tests for `parseKeyValue`, `parseKeyValueList`, `resolveScope`, and `singleScope` pass: `go test ./internal/cli/... -count=1 -run 'TestParse|TestScope'`

task_groups.title: Implement afc secrets subcommands in secrets_cmd.go

subtasks.title: Implement SecretsCmd() and afc secrets create
details: Create `internal/cli/secrets_cmd.go` with `SecretsCmd() *cobra.Command` returning a parent command with `Use: "secrets"`.
Implement `secretsCreateCmd()`: bind `--user` (BoolVar, default false), `--org` (StringVar), `--workspace` (StringVar) flags.

In `RunE`: parse the positional arg with `parseKeyValueList`; call `resolveScope`; iterate scopes in user → org → workspace order; for each scope call `CLIClientFromCmd`, then `client.DoRequest(ctx, "POST", path, body)`, then `CLIPrintResult`; on error call `CLIHandleError` and set `hadError = true`; after all scopes, if `hadError` return `apikit.NewCLIError(1, "")`.

subtasks.title: Implement afc secrets list subcommand
details: Implement `secretsListCmd()` with `--user`, `--org`, `--workspace` flags.
In `RunE`: call `singleScope` to get exactly one scope (exit code 2 if multiple); call `DoRequest(ctx, "GET", path, nil)`; call `CLIPrintResult` with the response.
API path: `/api/v1/user/secrets`, `/api/v1/orgs/:slug/secrets`, or `/api/v1/workspaces/:slug/secrets`.

subtasks.title: Implement afc secrets update subcommand
details: Implement `secretsUpdateCmd()` with `--user`, `--org`, `--workspace` flags.
In `RunE`: validate exactly one positional arg; call `parseKeyValue`; call `singleScope`; call `DoRequest(ctx, "PATCH", path+"/"+key, map[string]string{"value": value})`; call `CLIPrintResult`.
API path: `/api/v1/{scope}/secrets/:key`.

subtasks.title: Implement afc secrets delete subcommand
details: Implement `secretsDeleteCmd()` with `--user`, `--org`, `--workspace` flags.
In `RunE`: validate exactly one positional arg (the key name); call `singleScope`; call `DoRequest(ctx, "DELETE", path+"/"+key, nil)`.
On success (nil body returned for 204): skip `CLIPrintResult`; print `fmt.Fprintf(cmd.ErrOrStderr(), "Secret '%s' has been deleted.\n", key)` to stderr only.
On error: call `CLIHandleError`.

subtasks.title: Add all secrets subcommands to SecretsCmd parent
details: In `SecretsCmd()`, call `cmd.AddCommand(secretsCreateCmd(), secretsListCmd(), secretsUpdateCmd(), secretsDeleteCmd())`.
Ensure `Use`, `Short`, and `Args` fields are set appropriately on each subcommand (e.g. `cobra.ExactArgs(1)` for update/delete, `cobra.ExactArgs(1)` for create).

Multi-scope create test (TS-08-3, TS-08-4, TS-08-5) verifies user → org → workspace call order.
